title: Acts Bible Quiz - Chapter 15
description: Ten questions on Acts 15: the question of circumcision brought to Jerusalem, the letter to the Gentiles, and Paul and Barnabas parting.

questions.text: What did some men who came down from Judea teach the brothers?
questions.explanation: They taught that unless they were circumcised after the custom of Moses, they could not be saved.

answers.text: That without circumcision after the custom of Moses no one can be saved
That no Gentile could be saved at all, even after circumcision
That every believer must be baptized in Jerusalem itself
That the Sabbath must be kept in the custom of Moses to be saved

questions.text: Where were Paul and Barnabas appointed to go about this question?
questions.explanation: They were appointed to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.

answers.text: To Antioch, to the prophets and teachers
To Phoenicia, to the brothers there
To Jerusalem, to the apostles and elders
To Samaria, to the believers in the villages

questions.text: What did some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed say?
questions.explanation: They rose up and said it was necessary to circumcise them and to command them to keep the law of Moses.

answers.text: That the Gentiles should not be received at all
That the Gentiles must be circumcised and keep the law of Moses
That Paul should be forbidden to teach
That the law of Moses had come to an end

questions.text: How, in Peter's words, did God testify about the nations?
questions.explanation: God, who knows the heart, testified about them by giving them the Holy Spirit, just as he did to the believers in Jerusalem.

answers.text: By sending an angel to each of their cities
By giving them the law through Moses
By showing signs in the sky above them
By giving them the Holy Spirit, just as he did to us

questions.text: What did Peter call the demand that was being put on the neck of the disciples?
questions.explanation: He called it a yoke which neither their fathers nor they themselves were able to bear.

answers.text: A light burden that all could carry
A sign of the covenant with the fathers
A yoke that neither our fathers nor we were able to bear
A stumbling block laid by the Gentiles

questions.text: Who answered after the multitude had been silent?
questions.explanation: Acts 15:13 says that after they were silent, James answered and asked the brothers to listen to him.

answers.text: James
Peter
Barnabas
Silas

questions.text: What did James judge should be written to the Gentiles who turn to God?
questions.explanation: His judgment was that they should abstain from the pollution of idols, from sexual immorality, from what is strangled and from blood.

answers.text: To be circumcised after a year of teaching in the assembly
To keep the Sabbath and the yearly feasts of the fathers
To come up to Jerusalem each year to offer sacrifices
To abstain from idol pollution, sexual immorality, strangled things and blood

questions.text: Which men were chosen to be sent to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas?
questions.explanation: The apostles, elders and whole assembly chose Judas called Barsabbas and Silas, chief men among the brothers.

answers.text: Peter and James
Judas called Barsabbas and Silas
Simeon and Lucius of Cyrene
Barnabas and John called Mark

questions.text: What did Judas and Silas do in Antioch?
questions.explanation: Being prophets themselves, they encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them.

answers.text: They encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them
They appointed elders in the assembly there
They baptized the whole multitude in the city
They rebuked Paul before the assembly

questions.text: What happened after the sharp contention between Paul and Barnabas about Mark?
questions.explanation: They separated from each other: Barnabas took Mark and sailed to Cyprus, and Paul chose Silas and went through Syria and Cilicia.

answers.text: They separated: Paul took Mark, and Barnabas stayed in Antioch
They were reconciled and went on to Cyprus together
They separated: Barnabas sailed to Cyprus with Mark, and Paul chose Silas
They were both sent back to the apostles in Jerusalem
